activity.notes: Cyaxares is securely attested as a Median king, but the absolute chronology of the Median dynasty is reconstructed. Encyclopaedia Iranica gives the conventional Herodotean reconstruction c.625–585 BCE while also discussing alternatives around 620–584 BCE. ATLAS therefore stores c.625–c.585 BCE with both boundaries approximate rather than presenting them as exact accession and death dates.

sources.title: Cyaxares — Encyclopaedia Iranica
sources.citation_text: Iranica identifies Cyaxares as the historically attested Median king and notes that his reign extended to about 585/584 BCE under the standard reconstruction.
